fe.character.awareness.why: aimed outward: what the room feels is sharper than what Fe itself does
fe.character.control.why: conducts deliberately, toward a field it chooses
fe.character.endurance.why: rooms are its element — the field it maintains also carries it
fe.character.precision.why: reads a room to fine tolerances; masking is the one thing that beats the read
fe.character.speed.why: the read and the response are one operation
fe.energy.recovery.auxiliary: Quick, once the people it was held up for are settled.
fe.energy.recovery.dominant: Refills in company — the one function whose recovery is not solitary.
fe.energy.recovery.inferior: The social hangover: ~30 min of global dim, and it needs no translation.
fe.energy.recovery.shadow: Incomplete — what gets said from here is still costing something tomorrow.
fe.energy.recovery.tertiary: Slower: charm is affordable in bursts, not across an evening.

fe.feeder.ne.figure: Phantom carriers join the ring; the effort meter pays for them anyway.
fe.feeder.ne.mechanism: The ESFJ loop, with Si cut out: Ne — extraverted intuition — supplies people who are not in the room, and they arrive with real weight. What they might be thinking, how this could land — full price paid to harmonise with an audience the loop generated. The function that would break it is Si's record of how these people actually behave, which is exactly the one not consulted.
fe.feeder.ne.warn: Loop coupling: dominant and tertiary, both extraverted — the orbit runs entirely outside the self.

fe.feeder.ni.figure: Prediction ghosts ride each carrier, and the conducting aims at the ghost.
fe.feeder.ni.mechanism: Ni — introverted intuition — hands Fe a trajectory rather than a snapshot: not the mood someone is in, but the one they are heading for. Fewer people, read much further ahead. Uncanny when it lands; quietly presumptuous when it does not — this coupling answers questions nobody has asked yet, and occasionally the wrong ones.

fe.feeder.se.figure: Watch the gate swing — charisma with no direction.
fe.feeder.se.mechanism: The ENFJ loop, with Ni cut out: Se — extraverted sensing — drives the tending by whatever is loudest this instant. Agreement looks high moment to moment and never accumulates, because the target keeps moving. Both functions face outward, so nothing inside the loop can check it.
fe.feeder.se.warn: Loop coupling: dominant and tertiary, both extraverted — the orbit runs entirely outside the self.

fe.feeder.si.figure: A ribbon of past states trails every carrier, and the ring leans toward the ribbons.
fe.feeder.si.mechanism: Si — introverted sensing — hands Fe a stored record of each person: who they have been across every previous gathering. The target becomes precedent rather than the live average — hosting, tradition, the known-good evening, held up by someone who remembers how it goes. The failure mode: a room steered toward a version of itself it has outgrown.

fe.feeder.te.figure: The carriers freeze mid-phase while the ring keeps conducting yesterday's room.
fe.feeder.te.mechanism: Te — extraverted thinking — hands Fe verdicts about outcomes instead of perceptions of people, so the model of each person stops updating and the tending runs on last-known state. The room moves; the model does not; and no perceiving function is in the loop to say so. Real stacks alternate judging with perceiving for exactly this reason.
fe.feeder.te.warn: Unstable coupling: judging feeding judging, with nothing perceiving for either.

fe.fieldNotes.mirror.figure: On the glyphs, one section up: Fi's perimeter is computed from its centre and still burns alone; Fe's centre is computed from its perimeter, and you can watch it go dark.
fe.fieldNotes.mirror.mechanismHtml: Same element, opposite attitude — and the whole difference is where the measurement is taken. Fi measures at the centre: one fixed inner tone, and every arrival struck against it. Fe measures at the perimeter: the standard is computed from whoever is present, and moves when they do. That is why they fail in opposite directions: isolate Fi and the standard survives; isolate Fe and there is nothing left to take the measure of.

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.fake.figure: Calling it fake is calling a lighthouse insincere for shining at boats it doesn't know.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.fake.mechanism: The charge lands on Fe more than on any other function, and it inverts the mechanics. The warmth toward someone Fe privately finds difficult is not counterfeit feeling; it is infrastructure — the room's temperature is a thing this function maintains the way other people maintain bridges, and the maintenance does not stop for personal weather. The smile is load-bearing.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.fake.title: "You're Being Fake"

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.figure: A small chamber, suddenly at full pressure.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.mechanism: An INTP past the end of their reserves stops analysing and floods into inferior Fe: an abrupt, raw, badly-calibrated need to know they are wanted here, from someone who spent the whole week explaining that social convention is arbitrary. Not a personality change — a low-capacity seat taking a dominant-sized flood.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.grip.title: The Grip

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.mechanism: An ESFJ under stress pairs dominant Fe with tertiary Ne: tending toward people who are not in the room. What they might be thinking, what that message might have meant, how it is going to land. Full effort, no contact. The function that would break it — Si's actual record of how these people actually behave — is exactly the one the loop stops consulting.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.loop.title: The Loop

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForFi.figure: One conducts the weather; the other keeps a compass through it.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForFi.mechanism: Both read as "the warm one," so the attitudes get collapsed. The tell is whose signal moves them first. Fe registers the room's discomfort before its own — it can be personally furious and still catch the new hire's confusion mid-sentence. Fi registers its own line before the room's — it can sit peacefully in a tense meeting until a value is touched, then move against the whole field alone.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.mistakenForFi.title: Mistaken for Fi

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.read.figure: Eleven seconds of ring-work, no visible effort.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.read.mechanism: An ENFJ walks into a room and reorganises it in eleven seconds — seats a person next to the one who will draw them out, aims a question at whoever has been quiet, breaks a tension nobody else has registered yet. Asked afterwards what they did, they can rarely reconstruct it: the read and the response were one operation, and neither passed through language.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.read.title: The Read

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.roomThatBreaks.figure: The instrument measures lock; it cannot measure whether the lock deserves to hold.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.roomThatBreaks.mechanism: Some fields should not be harmonised: the meeting where a bad plan needs to die loudly, the consensus quietly excluding someone, the peace that is only the absence of a confrontation someone owes. Here Fe's reflex — close the gap, restore the agreement — works against the actual repair, smoothing a rupture that was doing surgical work. Some rooms need their coherence taken apart before it is worth having.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.roomThatBreaks.title: The Room That Needs to Break

fe.fieldNotes.vignette.showtime.figure: The ring lights up for the set, then goes home.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.showtime.mechanism: Tertiary Fe in an ESTP or ENTP: the room-read deployed in bursts, as a tool. The bar warms up, the client relaxes, the heckler gets folded into the act — genuine skill, genuinely enjoyed, and switched off in the parking lot without a second thought. The field was real while it lasted; what this seat does not do is stay behind to maintain it — the difference between playing the instrument and being its keeper.
fe.fieldNotes.vignette.showtime.title: The Showtime Switch

fe.hero.heading: The Resonance Field of {fn}
fe.hero.subtitle: A ring of other people, standing outside the chamber, coupled by a lattice Fe draws between them. The nucleus has no colour of its own — it is the average of whoever is currently in the room.
fe.lab.btn.celebrate.label: The Room Lifts
fe.lab.btn.covert.label: The Cold Current
fe.lab.btn.covert.sub: covert hostility behind a clean field
fe.lab.btn.deadlock.label: The Deadlock
fe.lab.btn.isolate.label: Cut Off
fe.lab.btn.isolate.sub: the ring goes dark; Fe finds out its colour
fe.lab.btn.reconcile.label: Reconciliation
fe.lab.btn.reconcile.sub: bridge a split field — the expensive one
fe.lab.btn.sync.label: Unspoken Sync
fe.lab.btn.sync.sub: one person shifts; Fe matches, for free
fe.lab.gate.open: the field is split — bridge it

fe.lab.narration.celebrate.figure: Twelve oscillators lock, and the interference inside the chamber turns entirely constructive — every crest landing on every other crest.
fe.lab.narration.celebrate.mechanism: Everyone is on the same frequency and holding the room costs almost nothing. This is the state Fe exists to produce.

fe.lab.narration.celebrate2.figure: Watch the differentiation readout fall as the hues average into one.
fe.lab.narration.celebrate2.mechanism: Perfect agreement is perfect sameness: a room this synchronised has stopped being able to tell its members apart, and the first person to sound a different note will be experienced as an attack. Fe's characteristic failure appears at the exact moment of its greatest success.

fe.lab.narration.covert.figure: The trust gap is the only instrument moving; underneath, a faint counter-rotating pattern beats against the displayed field.
fe.lab.narration.covert.mechanism: Agreement reads high and stress climbs anyway. Nothing is visibly wrong — the surface is clean, everyone reports fine — and yet something registers. This is the most characteristic Fe experience there is, and the hardest to defend: a real signal, detected before any evidence for it exists.

fe.lab.narration.covertHintCoarse: Press and hold each carrier: whether you find the masked pair depends on where Fe sits in the stack.
fe.lab.narration.covertHintHover: Hover the carriers: whether you find the masked pair depends on where Fe sits in the stack.

fe.lab.narration.deadlock.figure: The conducting term runs near maximum; the nucleus takes the mean of two opposites and turns grey.
fe.lab.narration.deadlock.mechanism: Two factions, locked in opposition, and Fe cannot decline the work — the effort is not voluntary, and it accomplishes nothing while the split holds. Being torn in half by a conflict you are not a party to is this exact state. Nothing here resolves on its own.

fe.lab.narration.gate: Reconciliation needs something to reconcile. Split the field first — spawn a deadlock, or let a cold current curdle into one — and this control unlocks.
fe.lab.narration.hover: You are sounding the ring. Each carrier reports what Fe can tell about them: their amplitude, whether they are in phase, and — if Fe's read is sharp enough at this stack position — whether what they display is what they are doing.
fe.lab.narration.intro: The ring runs unattended: seven independent oscillators, coupled to each other and nudged by whatever Fe can spare, drifting toward a concord that never quite finishes. Spawn an event and watch the field answer. The two rows are not decoration — everything above the divider makes the room more coherent, and everything below it takes something away.

fe.lab.narration.isolate.figure: The carriers go dark, and the nucleus goes with them.
fe.lab.narration.isolate.mechanism: This is the structural fact the whole page has been building toward: Fe's sense of itself is computed from the people around it, and with nobody there, there is no average to take. Fi alone still knows its own tone. Fe alone has nothing to be.

fe.lab.narration.isolate2.figure: The faint dashed carriers are not people; the effort meter cannot tell the difference.
fe.lab.narration.isolate2.mechanism: And the work does not stop with the room empty: an audience gets invented so there is something to harmonise with. Full cost, no contact — rumination, drawn exactly as it works.

fe.lab.narration.reconcile.figure: The coupling between the two clusters ramps from repulsive toward positive.
fe.lab.narration.reconcile.mechanism: Effort at maximum, stress climbing, and for a long first stretch nothing improves. This is what the work is: spending everything against a field that has not yet moved — a room being argued out of a position in real time.

fe.lab.narration.reconcile2.figure: The null closes, and one wavefront crosses both halves at once.
fe.lab.narration.reconcile2.mechanism: Now read the cost: around four units, against under half a unit for the earlier sync. Fe's best moment is its most expensive by an order of magnitude — the reason Fe-dominants burn out on rooms that will not resolve. Not because they care too much; because this is the actual price of the thing they are good at.

fe.lab.narration.sync.figure: A single filament connects one carrier to the nucleus — the only one-to-one link in this lab — and the effort meter stays flat.
fe.lab.narration.sync.mechanism: Nothing was said and nothing was spent. One person's mood shifted a few degrees and the response happened before anyone could have named it. The cheapest thing Fe does is the thing nobody can see it doing — which is also why it rarely gets credit.

fe.meta.title: Fe — Extraverted Feeling · CURRENTS

fe.slot.auxiliary.example: An INFJ hosts one dinner a month, for five people, and it is flawless.
fe.slot.auxiliary.figure: A smaller ring, fewer carriers, cleaner lock.
fe.slot.auxiliary.mechanism: In the second seat, the room still gets read accurately, but the tending is selective and scheduled: care delivered deliberately, to the people the dominant perceiving function has decided matter, rather than spread across every gathering. Warm in a narrower band, and considerably harder to exhaust.

fe.slot.critical.example: An ENFP silences a friend at dinner "for the table's sake" the table never asked for.
fe.slot.critical.figure: A harsh strobe across the ring, pointed at one carrier.
fe.slot.critical.mechanism: In the sixth seat, the room-read turns into verdicts about other people's effect on the room — you are making everyone uncomfortable, nobody wants to hear this — delivered with total confidence, rarely checked, and aimed at whoever is nearest. The person delivering it is not, at that moment, tending anything.

fe.slot.demon.example: A meeting is convened "to hear everyone out" whose seating, order, and framing exist to leave one chair alone.
fe.slot.demon.figure: The ring is driven apart on purpose while the readout still shows green.
fe.slot.demon.mechanism: The eighth seat runs rarest and worst. When it activates, group feeling becomes a weapon: a tone is manufactured in order to isolate someone inside it, while the person doing it still reports that this is in everyone's interest. It is the least practised seat in the stack, and unmistakable when it surfaces.

fe.slot.dominant.example: The host seats two strangers next to each other and both leave thinking the evening simply went well.
fe.slot.dominant.figure: CURRENTS draws this as a ring of carriers in near-lock — both needles, believed and actual, sitting on top of each other.
fe.slot.dominant.mechanism: In the first seat, the state of the room is the primary datum, read continuously and without effort — who has gone quiet, who is being talked over, where the tension sits. Harmony is not a preference but a load-bearing structure: something the person holds up, usually unasked, and usually unnoticed until they stop.

fe.slot.inferior.example: An INTP who lectured all week on the arbitrariness of small talk asks, at 1 a.m., whether anyone would notice if they stopped coming.
fe.slot.inferior.figure: A dim ring, read at low resolution, flooding all at once.
fe.slot.inferior.mechanism: In the fourth seat, belonging costs the most and is trusted the least. Social convention reads as arbitrary noise for long stretches; under real depletion an abrupt, badly-calibrated need to know they are wanted here takes over — Quenk's grip — landing far too hard or not at all, and surprising them most of anyone.

fe.slot.opposing.example: An ISFP at the team-building day performs every ritual perfectly, one degree too exactly, and everyone feels it.
fe.slot.opposing.figure: Below the waterline, the ring plays the field's pattern back at it, inverted.
fe.slot.opposing.mechanism: The fifth seat opens the shadow — the four positions a person runs rarely, and mostly without noticing. Here group-tending runs contrary: when an inner value is pressed, the person matches the room's tone with unnerving precision precisely in order to refuse it — harmony real enough to be recognised, and pointedly withheld.

fe.slot.tertiary.example: An ESTP folds the heckler into the act, gets the room, and forgets everyone's names by the parking lot.
fe.slot.tertiary.figure: The ring lights in bursts and dims between them.
fe.slot.tertiary.mechanism: In the third seat, warmth is an instrument: genuinely felt, deliberately deployed, and retired when the moment is won. The read is good enough for the next twenty minutes and rarely checked afterwards — which is what tells you it is the third seat and not the first.

fe.slot.trickster.example: An INTJ leaves the party early, certain they were being laughed at, over a story told in their honour.
fe.slot.trickster.figure: Watch the needles: what this seat believes about the room and what is true have visibly come apart.
fe.slot.trickster.mechanism: In the seventh seat, the social read returns confident errors: warmth taken for mockery, a joke for an attack, an ally for a threat — and the misjudgement is acted on immediately, without review. The blindness is real, not tactical.

fe.zoneA.canvasAria: Interactive visual representation of Extraverted Feeling as a resonance field: a ring of independent oscillators standing outside a hexagonal chamber, coupled to each other by a lattice drawn between them, with conducting impulses leaving the nucleus through a gap in the rim. The interference pattern inside the chamber is produced entirely by the carriers outside it, and the nucleus takes its colour from their average. Point at or press a carrier to sound what Fe can tell about them
fe.zoneB.ageNote: With age, lower stack positions gain fidelity and duty cycle — and the ring itself grows larger, reads more of itself at once, and steadies.
fe.zoneB.heading: The Eight Faces of Fe
fe.zoneB.lede: Click any position to see how the room changes hands — from the dominant's effortless read to the demon's manufactured concord. Watch the two needles on the glyph: what Fe believes about the room, and what is actually true. At Dominant they sit on top of each other; by Trickster they have visibly come apart, and the misreading is being acted on. Drag the maturity slider to watch the ring grow and steady with age.
fe.zoneB.stageAria: Glyph stage showing the selected stack position, with a believed-versus-actual concord readout
fe.zoneC.heading: What Feeds Into Fe?
fe.zoneC.lede: Extraverted judging is fed by introverted perception — Fe's real partners are Ni and Si, the inner perceivers that tell it what the room is made of. Click a feeder and watch what Fe starts conducting toward.
fe.zoneC.unstableDefault: Unstable coupling: judging feeding judging, with nothing perceiving for either.
fe.zoneD.canvasAria: The Fe resonance lab: a ring of coupled carriers around an open hexagonal chamber, where harmony events lock the field into constructive interference and dissonance events mask, split, or sever it. Point at or press a carrier to sound what Fe can tell about them
fe.zoneD.heading: The Resonance Lab
fe.zoneD.lede: Ti verifies against its lattice and Fi against a core tone. Fe verifies against the field between people, so this lab spawns its events into the room rather than into the chamber. Three make it more coherent, three take something away — and one of them costs more than the other five combined.
fe.zoneD.legendHtml: Reading the glyph: each person carries a hand showing their phase — when the room agrees, the hands line up. The band around the nucleus is the room's colours by weight, and the disc inside it is their average. That disc is the only colour Fe has.
fe.zoneE.lede: Patterns from the wild — how Fe shows up in daily life.
